items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Al came on just after I joined. He came on in January of ’68.

ctx.x: Going back to Buddy for a minute, of course it was mostly young guys but there was some older veterans in that band like Al Porcino.
Yeah, Al came on just after I joined. He came on in January of ’68.
Were those guys, did they teach you anything?
